CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_users_email ON users (email)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_users_zoom_token ON users (zoom_token)

CREATE TABLE assignment_submissions (
	submission_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	assignment_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	student_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	content TEXT, 
	file_path VARCHAR(500), 
	file_name VARCHAR(200), 
	submitted_at DATETIME, 
	is_late BOOLEAN, 
	score INTEGER, 
	feedback TEXT, 
	graded_at DATETIME, 
	graded_by VARCHAR(36), 
	status VARCHAR(20), 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	updated_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (submission_id), 
	CONSTRAINT unique_assignment_submission UNIQUE (assignment_id, student_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(assignment_id) REFERENCES assignments (assignment_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(student_id) REFERENCES students (student_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(graded_by) REFERENCES users (user_id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

CREATE TABLE assignments (
	assignment_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT NOT NULL, 
	course_id VARCHAR(36), 
	teacher_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	target_student_id VARCHAR(36), 
	assignment_type VARCHAR(20), 
	difficulty VARCHAR(20), 
	max_score INTEGER, 
	due_date DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	late_submission_allowed BOOLEAN, 
	late_penalty_percent INTEGER, 
	submission_type VARCHAR(20), 
	status VARCHAR(20), 
	is_published BOOLEAN, 
	total_submissions INTEGER, 
	graded_submissions INTEGER, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	updated_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (assignment_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(course_id) REFERENCES courses (course_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(teacher_id) REFERENCES users (user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(target_student_id) REFERENCES students (student_id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

CREATE TABLE attendance (
	attendance_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	session_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	student_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	enrollment_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20), 
	checked_at DATETIME, 
	checked_by VARCHAR(36), 
	checkin_method VARCHAR(20), 
	participation_score INTEGER, 
	comprehension_score INTEGER, 
	adjustment_created BOOLEAN, 
	notes TEXT, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	updated_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (attendance_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES course_sessions (session_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(student_id) REFERENCES students (student_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(enrollment_id) REFERENCES course_enrollments (enrollment_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(checked_by) REFERENCES users (user_id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

CREATE TABLE br_assignment_heads (
	submission_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	revision_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	legacy_digest TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (submission_id), 
	CHECK (typeof(generation)='integer' AND generation>=1), 
	CHECK (length(legacy_digest)=64 AND legacy_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), 
	FOREIGN KEY(submission_id) REFERENCES assignment_submissions (submission_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_br_head_revision FOREIGN KEY(submission_id, revision_id) REFERENCES br_assignment_revisions (submission_id, revision_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

CREATE TABLE br_assignment_outbox (
	event_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	command_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	recipient_user_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	notification_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	event_type TEXT NOT NULL, 
	payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	delivery_state TEXT NOT NULL, 
	attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (event_id), 
	CHECK (event_type='assignment_submitted'), 
	CHECK (delivery_state='pending'), 
	CHECK (typeof(attempt_count)='integer' AND attempt_count=0), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_br_outbox_event UNIQUE (command_id, recipient_user_id, event_type), 
	FOREIGN KEY(command_id) REFERENCES br_assignment_receipts (command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(recipient_user_id) REFERENCES users (user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	UNIQUE (notification_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(notification_id) REFERENCES notifications (notification_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

CREATE TABLE br_assignment_receipts (
	command_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	actor_user_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL, 
	assignment_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	submission_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	revision_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	request_digest TEXT NOT NULL, 
	response_status INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	response_body TEXT NOT NULL, 
	committed_at TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (command_id), 
	CHECK (length(request_digest)=64 AND request_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), 
	CHECK (length(idempotency_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 128), 
	CHECK (response_status IN (200,201)), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_br_actor_key UNIQUE (actor_user_id, idempotency_key), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_br_receipt_revision UNIQUE (revision_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_user_id) REFERENCES users (user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(assignment_id) REFERENCES assignments (assignment_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(submission_id) REFERENCES assignment_submissions (submission_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_br_receipt_revision FOREIGN KEY(submission_id, revision_id) REFERENCES br_assignment_revisions (submission_id, revision_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

CREATE TABLE br_assignment_revisions (
	revision_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	submission_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	revision_no INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	parent_revision_id TEXT, 
	actor_user_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	content TEXT NOT NULL, 
	file_manifest TEXT NOT NULL, 
	payload_digest TEXT NOT NULL, 
	legacy_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL, 
	legacy_digest TEXT NOT NULL, 
	enrollment_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	course_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	session_id TEXT, 
	scope_state TEXT NOT NULL, 
	program_id TEXT, 
	edition_id TEXT, 
	rubric_id TEXT, 
	captured_at TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (revision_id), 
	CHECK (typeof(revision_no)='integer' AND revision_no>=1), 
	CHECK (scope_state IN ('explicit_scope_checked','unknown')), 
	CHECK (program_id IS NULL AND edition_id IS NULL AND rubric_id IS NULL), 
	CHECK (length(payload_digest)=64 AND payload_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), 
	CHECK (length(legacy_digest)=64 AND legacy_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_br_revision_no UNIQUE (submission_id, revision_no), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_br_revision_target UNIQUE (submission_id, revision_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(submission_id) REFERENCES assignment_submissions (submission_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_user_id) REFERENCES users (user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(enrollment_id) REFERENCES course_enrollments (enrollment_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(course_id) REFERENCES courses (course_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES course_sessions (session_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_br_revision_parent FOREIGN KEY(submission_id, parent_revision_id) REFERENCES br_assignment_revisions (submission_id, revision_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

CREATE TABLE correction_attachments (
	attachment_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	essay_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	version_id VARCHAR(36), 
	original_filename VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	stored_filename VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	file_path VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	file_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	file_size INTEGER, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (attachment_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(essay_id) REFERENCES essays (essay_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

CREATE TABLE course_enrollments (
	enrollment_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	course_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	student_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20), 
	enrolled_at DATETIME, 
	completed_at DATETIME, 
	payment_status VARCHAR(20), 
	paid_sessions INTEGER,

	weekly_fee INTEGER,

CREATE TABLE course_sessions (
	session_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	course_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	session_number INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	session_date DATE NOT NULL, 
	start_time TIME,

CREATE TABLE courses (

	course_name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,

CREATE TRIGGER br_assignment_heads_delete_guard BEFORE DELETE ON br_assignment_heads BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'delete'); END

CREATE TRIGGER br_assignment_heads_insert_conflict_guard BEFORE INSERT ON br_assignment_heads WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM br_assignment_heads WHERE submission_id=NEW.submission_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'insert_conflict'); END

CREATE TRIGGER br_assignment_heads_transition_insert_guard BEFORE INSERT ON br_assignment_heads WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM br_assignment_heads WHERE submission_id=NEW.submission_id) AND (NEW.generation != 1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM br_assignment_revisions r WHERE r.submission_id=NEW.submission_id AND r.revision_id=NEW.revision_id AND r.revision_no=1 AND r.parent_revision_id IS NULL AND r.legacy_digest=NEW.legacy_digest)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'transition_insert'); END

CREATE TRIGGER br_assignment_heads_transition_update_guard BEFORE UPDATE ON br_assignment_heads WHEN NEW.submission_id != OLD.submission_id OR NEW.generation != OLD.generation+1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM br_assignment_revisions r WHERE r.submission_id=NEW.submission_id AND r.revision_id=NEW.revision_id AND r.revision_no=NEW.generation AND r.parent_revision_id=OLD.revision_id AND r.legacy_digest=NEW.legacy_digest) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'transition_update'); END
CREATE TRIGGER br_assignment_outbox_delete_guard BEFORE DELETE ON br_assignment_outbox BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'delete'); END

CREATE TRIGGER br_assignment_outbox_insert_conflict_guard BEFORE INSERT ON br_assignment_outbox WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM br_assignment_outbox WHERE event_id=NEW.event_id OR notification_id=NEW.notification_id OR (command_id=NEW.command_id AND recipient_user_id=NEW.recipient_user_id AND event_type=NEW.event_type)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'insert_conflict'); END
CREATE TRIGGER br_assignment_outbox_update_guard BEFORE UPDATE ON br_assignment_outbox BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'update'); END
CREATE TRIGGER br_assignment_receipts_delete_guard BEFORE DELETE ON br_assignment_receipts BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'delete'); END

CREATE TRIGGER br_assignment_receipts_insert_conflict_guard BEFORE INSERT ON br_assignment_receipts WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM br_assignment_receipts WHERE command_id=NEW.command_id OR (actor_user_id=NEW.actor_user_id AND idempotency_key=NEW.idempotency_key) OR revision_id=NEW.revision_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'insert_conflict'); END
CREATE TRIGGER br_assignment_receipts_update_guard BEFORE UPDATE ON br_assignment_receipts BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'update'); END
CREATE TRIGGER br_assignment_revisions_delete_guard BEFORE DELETE ON br_assignment_revisions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'delete'); END

CREATE TRIGGER br_assignment_revisions_insert_conflict_guard BEFORE INSERT ON br_assignment_revisions WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM br_assignment_revisions WHERE revision_id=NEW.revision_id OR (submission_id=NEW.submission_id AND revision_no=NEW.revision_no)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'insert_conflict'); END

CREATE TRIGGER br_assignment_revisions_lineage_insert_guard BEFORE INSERT ON br_assignment_revisions WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM br_assignment_revisions WHERE revision_id=NEW.revision_id OR (submission_id=NEW.submission_id AND revision_no=NEW.revision_no)) AND (NOT ((NEW.revision_no=1 AND NEW.parent_revision_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM br_assignment_heads WHERE submission_id=NEW.submission_id)) OR (NEW.revision_no>1 AND NEW.parent_revision_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.parent_revision_id != NEW.revision_id AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM br_assignment_heads h JOIN br_assignment_revisions p ON p.revision_id=h.revision_id AND p.submission_id=h.submission_id WHERE h.submission_id=NEW.submission_id AND h.generation=NEW.revision_no-1 AND h.revision_id=NEW.parent_revision_id AND p.revision_no=NEW.revision_no-1)))) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'lineage_insert'); END
CREATE TRIGGER br_assignment_revisions_update_guard BEFORE UPDATE ON br_assignment_revisions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'update'); END
